name: San Joaquin County, CA
findings: San Joaquin County has 1,668 nonprofit organizations. 621 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 458 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, San Joaquin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few foundation organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 foundation organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 215 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
